Refined contemporary living room in neutral charcoal grey, pale grey limestone and brushed aluminium, subtle natural cool daylight, quiet luxury. On the RIGHT HALF only, one very large extremely thin perfectly rectangular flat-screen television, shown almost straight on, resting on a long low monolithic limestone console; screen displays a calm desaturated icy mountain landscape in midnight blue, silver and cool white, no sunset, no orange. The ENTIRE LEFT 44 percent is a calm dark charcoal textured wall and a low dark sofa edge, with ample clean negative space for white website heading to be added in HTML. Rightmost TV must remain fully inside canvas with at least 7 percent right safe margin; TV top and bottom have generous margins. Architectural magazine photography, impeccable straight lines, believable perspective, restrained satin materials, soft indirect light, exceptionally sharp details. No people, no letters, no logos, no text, no watermarks, no glowing rings, no sci-fi effects, no colored ambient light, no purple, no pink, no gold, no clutter. This is a brand-neutral illustrative room scene, not a claim to show a particular exact model.

Silver-grey neutral surroundings, naturally purple phone. No text, no captions, no badges, no graphic overlays, no extra lens, no blue/pink/gold lighting, no neon, no watermark.
